articles.title: Captives and fronting are reshaping who actually carries the risk in Canada's MGA market
articles.summary: Zurich Canada and Aon Reinsurance leaders report a surge in Canadian captive formations alongside MGA fronting arrangements as large domestic enterprises retain predictable frequency losses and optimize risk capital.

articles.title: Data centres are rewriting the rules of Canadian construction insurance
articles.summary: With Canadian data centre construction projected to reach $8.6 billion by 2031, Gallagher and Aon brokers highlight emerging opportunities for captive retention structures to bridge mega-project capacity gaps.

articles.title: BMA updates guidance for segregated and separate account insurers
articles.summary: The Bermuda Monetary Authority issued updated guidance effective January 1, 2027 for segregated and separate account insurers, clarifying governance, risk management, and targeted reporting expectations for cell-captive participants.

articles.title: IMAC: Cayman gets boost from Q3 2026 numbers
articles.summary: CIMA issued eight new international insurer licences in Q3 2026, bringing Cayman's year-to-date formations to 28 and total international insurers to 720 representing $62 billion in premiums.

articles.title: Bermuda Court Rules on Captive Insurance Manager's Duty of Care to Shareholders
articles.summary: Bermuda's Supreme Court ruled that a captive manager owed contractual duties to its client companies rather than individual shareholders, underscoring the importance of clear governance and management agreements.

articles.title: SIIA Survey Finds Strong Captive Insurance Growth Outlook for 2026
articles.summary: SIIA's sixth annual captive survey finds 90.6% of brokers anticipate five-year demand growth, driven by pricing predictability, disciplined claims management, and rising interest in medical stop-loss and cyber coverages.
